evidence.title: CyrusOne and Calpine Announce New Hyperscale Data Center Development in Texas
evidence.excerpt: CyrusOne's July 2025 release names the Bosque County campus DFW10, says CyrusOne is constructing it adjacent to the Thad Hill Energy Center, and describes an initial 190 MW power and grid agreement.

evidence.title: Calpine and CyrusOne Announce Phase 2 of Powered Land Agreement to Support Hyperscale Data Center at Thad Hill Energy Center in Texas
evidence.excerpt: The November 3, 2025 dateline says a 210 MW contract completes the explicit 400 MW power-supply agreement for the currently under-construction CyrusOne facility at Thad Hill.
